channel.title: Independent Journal review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: Susie Wiles Says Trump Will ‘Campaign Like It’s 2024 Again’ For Midterms
item.description: White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles said on "The Mom View" Monday that President Donald Trump will campaign as aggressively in the 2026 midterms as he did during the 2024 presidential election.

item.title: Assad Regime Collapse Stems Europe’s Refugee Tide As Syrians Head Home, But The Trend May Slow
item.description: The tide of Syrian refugees that flooded Europe for over a decade is turning, as Syrians return home after the war-torn nation overthrew its dictator and established a new interim government.

item.title: Trump Admin Moves To Give China Leg Up In Key Arms Race
item.description: President Donald Trump announced Monday that his administration will allow U.S. chipmaker NVIDIA to ship its advanced H200 artificial intelligence processors to approved buyers in China and other countries.

item.title: Netflix To Platform Film About ‘Trans Woman’ Who Yearns For Coal Mines
item.description: Netflix is releasing a movie called the "Queen of Coal" to American audiences Dec. 19, which will follow a "trans woman" as the individual pursues their goal of working in the mines.

item.title: Clinton-Appointed Judge Rules Trump Cannot Block New Wind Farms
item.description: Clinton-nominated Judge Patti Saris ruled Monday to overturn President Donald Trump's day-one executive order directing agencies to pause issuing new or renewed wind project permits pending a "comprehensive assessment."

item.title: Supreme Court Signals Major Shift Toward Expanding Presidential Firing Power
item.description: Such a ruling would hand President Donald Trump a significant boost in his drive to assert more control over the federal regulatory machine.

item.title: Fired FBI Agents Say Kneeling Was Tactical, Not Political, Sue to Get Jobs Back
item.description: They insist the knee-drop wasn’t a show of solidarity with any movement or a stance against President Donald Trump, but a last-resort tactic meant to keep a dangerous situation from spiraling.

item.title: Jordan’s NASCAR Antitrust Fight Heats Up as Economist Says Teams Are Owed $364M
item.description: His analysis draws on lost revenue, reduced market value, and profits that would have flowed to teams under what he described as a more competitive system.

item.title: MTG Implies Trump Is Israel First
item.description: Departing Republican Georgia Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene fired back at President Donald Trump Monday by pointing to what she called her "America First" credentials.

item.title: GABRIELLA HOFFMAN And NICOLE KIPRILOV: Our Parents Fled The Iron Curtain. Don’t Be Deceived By Mamdani’s Socialism
item.description: Our families escaped socialism in Europe for freedom in the United States to live the American Dream. Nevertheless, socialist New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mandani’s agenda echoes the very devastating policies our families fled.
